readerContract.humanQuestion: If ChatGPT can build a dashboard from my company data, what should I trust and check before I use it?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Understand how connected sources, company definitions and permissions shape a Data agent answer, and know what to verify before sharing or acting on it.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No knowledge of databases, business intelligence tools, metric definitions, connectors or workplace access controls is assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: A fluent question is only the front door: the connected sources, the organization’s definitions and the account’s permissions determine what the agent can retrieve and how it interprets the result.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A manager asks why sales slowed, receives a polished dashboard and must decide whether the figure is reliable enough to share.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A dated September 10 product report prepared privately for possible September 11 publication after an actual morning freshness check.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I know which questions make a generated dashboard safer to use at work.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: OpenAI’s new Data agent can turn an ordinary-language business question into a dashboard, but the result is shaped by the sources, definitions and permissions that the organization has connected.
causalSequence: A professional asks a business question in ordinary language.
The Data agent retrieves only from approved connected sources and within the account’s existing permissions.
It uses the organization’s metric definitions and data relationships to interpret those records.
It produces an answer or dashboard that a person should verify against the source and definition before sharing or authorizing a connected action.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A manager asks why sales slowed and checks which sales definition, date range and source generated the dashboard before sending it to leadership.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: An operations lead asks why support tickets rose and verifies whether duplicate tickets and reopened cases are included before changing staffing.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Before sharing a Data agent result, open its evidence, name the metric definition, compare one important figure with the trusted report, and keep sending or changing records behind approval.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story; LAiDIES Read; What This Means for You; Cocktail Party; source-linked Class Notes.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: One product release and one decision mechanism; no connector inventory, benchmark contest or generic AI-at-work checklist.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: The article could repeat OpenAI’s ease and customer claims as proof of accuracy, or imply that permissions alone guarantee a correct dashboard.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Bind each product claim to current OpenAI pages, bind the missing benchmark to same-day independent reporting, and require the reader action to test one figure and definition.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A reader can explain why a polished dashboard may still be wrong and can name the three checks before using it.
